metadata.title: The Nieuwland number of the Octahedron
metadata.abstract: We prove that the Nieuwland number of the Octahedron is $3\sqrt{2}/4$. Along the way, we provide an elementary proof that Rupert's problem for the Octahedron admits no solution in which the outer projection is a hexagon.

analysis.workSummary: 确定正八面体 Nieuwland 数为 3√2/4，并排除外投影为六边形的一类 Rupert 构形。
analysis.breakthrough: 把具体穿孔极值问题化为精确常数。
analysis.limitations: 不直接解决其他多面体的 Rupert 问题。 当前为摘要级分析，方法及结论须回查原文。
analysis.aiEvidence: Gemini 辅助绘图，Claude 校对并指出早期稿件的不准确之处。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.10788v1 — Acknowledgments and statement about AI usage
analysis.priorityReason: 凸多面体极值结果具体，但与曲率主线联系有限。
